# Dutch Oven

A dutch oven is a heavy, lidded pot, usually cast iron, that home bakers use
as a small oven inside the oven. A loaf bakes within it so the steam the
dough releases stays trapped around the crust, keeping it supple while the
loaf is still expanding.^[raw/articles/the-science-of-a-good-loaf.md]

## Why it matters

- Traps steam, which keeps the crust soft until the loaf has finished
  springing.
- Steadies the heat under the base of the loaf, so the bottom browns evenly
  instead of scorching.
